name: @kiwa-test/desktop
description: Desktop test harness for kiwa v0.7 — 12 axis semantics + v0.4 adapter + fidelity harness + v0.5 spawn stub + v0.6 実 spawn 実行 + v0.7 real behavior runner (12 axis 別 real 経路 behavior 差別化 pattern + fidelity harness 拡張で metadata + duration diff early warning 検知) を pair layer 化。 real 経路 = 各 axis 別に production-style 実運用 behavior を simulate (electron real app ID + auto-updater 128MB update + fs-permissions production path + screen-recording 4K chunks + clipboard production URL 等)、 shape 契約 preserving = neutralEvents + eventCount は mock と一致、 metadata + state のみ差別化、 summarizeFidelityBehaviorDiff で per-axis behavior diff summary 取得可能。 v1.62 で kiwa 縦深化 pair 第 14 の第 7 段 (depth-7 pattern 新設 candidate)、 v1.55-v1.61 4 PR rhythm 継承 (9 milestone 連続 = 36 PR 連続同 rhythm)、 systematic pattern 37 度目適用 (uniform real behavior runner)、 backward compat 絶対維持 (v0.1-v0.6 API 変更 0)、 40 milestone snippet streak 到達、 depth-6 pattern 2 例目 candidate (Desktop v0.7 = depth-7 拡張)。

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
